panels.description: Nexus ecological lab. An empty krill tank sits under emergency light. Pale sediment layers the bottom and blue ice presses through the rear wall. Leave upper-left for a location caption.
Sitara wipes frost from the sensor display. A graph shows sea-ice duration shortening beside failed krill reproduction; preserve correlation language only. Leave the top for Sitara's dialogue.
Sitara's TJ fabricates a small conductive bridge from sorted feedstock. Its reserve indicator visibly drops. Leave upper-right for a sound effect and upper-left for TJ dialogue.

The sensor archive returns a concise result while Roman looks through the glass at the empty tank. Keep the tank dominant behind him. Leave top-left for the result caption and bottom-right for Roman's dialogue.

items.text: The tank failed when the ice season shortened.
